title: Sandi Pukul Sembilan
subject: a wife in Pariaman and her husband working in Medan talk every night at nine on a ham radio rig, so the whole street listens, and they speak only in Minang proverbs so the neighbours cannot follow
caption: Minang rabab Pariaman ballad, slow rolling pulse with a gentle swing. Bowed rabab Pariaman carrying the vocal line with sliding ornaments, saluang flute answering in long breaths, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass, soft frame drum on the off-beats. Small-room warmth, close natural reverb. Male vocal, mid-low register, steady sung melody with traditional ornament. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, D minor. Longing and warm mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no dangdut, no pop gloss.
lyrics:
[Intro - rabab, saluang]

[Verse 1]
Pukul sembilan malam radio menyala
Dari Medan kupanggil namamu pelan
Tetangga duduk di teras, pasang telinga
Kita bicara pakai pepatah saja

[Pre-Chorus]
Air beriak tanda tak dalam
Begitu katamu, aku paham maksudnya

[Chorus]
Sandi pukul sembilan, jangan terlambat
Suaramu patah-patah, tapi sampai juga
Sandi pukul sembilan, aku di sini
Pepatah kita rahasia sepasang

[Verse 2]
Kau cerita jemuran, hujan di Pariaman
Aku jawab, sekali layar terkembang
Pak Haji tertawa, tak ngerti artinya
Anak-anak tebak, siapa yang rindu

[Pre-Chorus]
Sinyalnya hilang, suaramu berdesis
Kuulang tiga kali, sampai kau jawab

[Chorus]
Sandi pukul sembilan, jangan terlambat
Suaramu patah-patah, tapi sampai juga
Sandi pukul sembilan, kau di sana
Pepatah kita tak butuh terjemahan

[Bridge - rabab alone]
Hari Minggu nanti kutukar giliran
Biar kau yang dengar suaraku dari dekat

[Chorus]
Sandi pukul sembilan, aku pulang
Tak perlu radio, cukup ketuk pintu
Sandi pukul sembilan, buka pintunya
Pepatah terakhir kubisik langsung

[Outro - saluang, rabab fade]
